summary: One P&R iteration was run with starting parameters and no changes. Reports show 0 route DRC errors, 0 antenna violations, 0 slew/cap violations, and positive setup (worst 8.938 ns) and hold (worst 0.104 ns) slack in all 9 corners. 8 max-fanout hits are clock-buffer outputs allowed under the clock-tree rule (limit 20). No congestion figure was in the inputs.
assumptions: All numbers are quoted from the input reports; the total cost 0.053678 USD is the sum of the six per-agent values.
Final decision on pass or fail belongs to the runtime checks, not to this summary.
Hold buffers (79) and timing-repair buffers (178) are reported separately from the 9 clock buffers.
No budget figure was provided, so none is stated.
Slack values are quoted from the independent STA data (setup_ws_by_corner, hold_ws_by_corner); post-CTS values come from cts_report.json.
The 2.0 ns skew target is taken from reports/cts_tool.json because the spec states none.
The 8 max-fanout entries on clkbuf_3_*__f_clk/X are allowed because the tool data labels them 'clock-tree net, limit 20' and all values (11 to 17) are within 20.
The PnR iteration 1 data is the final state since it is the only iteration.
The data in reports/pnr_iterations.json iteration 1 is the final state, since it is the only iteration.
Tree skew is the tool's reported skew minus the clock uncertainty of 0.25 ns, as given in the tool data.
open_issues: 8 clock-tree fanout entries above limit 10 need human confirmation of the clock-tree rule.
DFT is a plan only; scan pin decision pending.
Equivalence check not provided; not proven.
Hold margin thin (0.104 ns worst in final STA).
Hold slack is the thinnest margin: 0.1040085824683123 ns at min_ff_n40C_1v95 in final STA, and 0.013112872270280695 ns at nom_ff_n40C_1v95 right after CTS.
Hold slack is thin at nom_ff_n40C_1v95 (0.013112872270280695 ns); needs confirmation in final STA.
Maximum fanout limit 10 is exceeded on 8 clock-tree buffer outputs (11 to 17); allowed by the clock-tree rule (limit 20) in the tool data, but a human may want to confirm that rule is acceptable.
No clock transition data in the tool output.
No congestion data; post-CTS slack only for 3 nominal corners.
No congestion or routing overflow figure is present in the input files, so congestion state is not quoted.
No cost budget in inputs, so no spend vs budget or forecast.
PDK and library choice, and the IO delay and area values, are marked DEFAULT - needs G1 review in the spec.
Post-CTS slack is given only for the three nominal corners; max_* and min_* corners are not covered for REQ-021.
